# Lucky Machines Game Core

Game Core provides modular smart-contract infrastructure for on-chain games: boards, zones, player state, transit batching, and randomness integration.

## Canonical Files

- `README.md` - architecture, installation, and testing
- `contracts/src/v0.0/GameBoard.sol` - board and transit lifecycle
- `contracts/src/v0.0/GameFactory.sol` - game instance creation
- `contracts/src/v0.0/PlayerRegistry.sol` - per-game player registration
- `contracts/src/v0.0/PlayZone.sol` - zone behavior primitives
- `contracts/src/v0.0/Ruleset.sol` - configurable game rules
- `contracts/src/v0.0/VRFVerifier.sol` - AutoLoop-compatible VRF proof verifier

## Transit and Batch APIs

- `queueExitToPaths(gameID, playerAddresses, pathIndices, transitID)`
- `startTransit(transitID)`
- `_progressTransit(transitID)`
- `getTransitLength(gameID, transitID)`
- `transitProgress(gameID, transitID)`
- `transitComplete(gameID, transitID)`

## Test Entry Points

- JavaScript: `npm test`
- Solidity (Foundry): `npm run test:solidity`
- Transit integration tests:
  - `test/GameBoardTransit.t.sol`
  - `test/GameBoardTransitBatch.t.sol`

## Related Repositories

- `../AUTOLOOP_STUFF/autoloop` - automation contract layer
- `../AUTOLOOP_STUFF/autoloop-worker` - off-chain controller
- `../RCS_Racerverse_Transit_System` - hub-style transit architecture
